source: National Archives Constitution Amendment XIII Section 1
review_notes: Codex reviewed both prohibited forms and both jurisdiction scopes. The criminal-punishment exception qualifies each prohibition rather than becoming an unconditional assertion. This section informed parser development.
text:
AMENDMENT XIII
Section 1.
Neither slavery nor involuntary servitude, except as a punishment for crime whereof the party shall have been duly convicted, shall exist within the United States, or any place subject to their jurisdiction.
